_note: Per-fixture run context, so the golden set can pin report.md sections that a single validate.py pass cannot produce. `passes` is the revision count recorded into findings.json. `resolved` holds `check` or `check:severity` selectors whose findings are marked resolved:true, simulating the build-deck revise loop — validate.py never emits a resolved finding, so without this the revision branch of report.md section 6 and the '*(resolved by revision)*' finding suffix stay unpinned (R10-L3). Fixtures absent from this file run at passes 0 with nothing resolved.

05-placeholder-data.json.why: Simulates a deck that reached pass 2 with the missing chart and KPI sources added; the unverified placeholder table survived the revision, as placeholders always do.
